answer_1.quote: Recent large language models (LLMs) have greatly promoted the progress of the field of natural language processing (NLP) due to their excellent zeroshot capabilities in various downstream tasks.
answer_1.outputs: LLMs generate actions in multi-agent game environments such as bidding in auctions, playing cards in Hanabi, describing words in Undercover, and placing pieces in board games.

answer_2.quote: We adopt the TrueSkill™ ratings as the evaluation metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct an extensive experiment and human evaluation among 14 different sizes and types of LLMs.
answer_4.guideline: Human players manually played five games with seven LLMs each, and the outcomes were used to evaluate LLM performance; additionally, 50 game records were manually analyzed for communication and opponent modeling capabilities.
